div.div:
Legend
① input → movement / fire
② pickup trigger swaps weapon
③ hitscan raycast → damage + impulse + FX
④ charged throw spawns a physics projectile
⑤ bounce-count fuse → radial explosion
⑥ spawner keeps targets alive
